item_id: 10.1523/jneurosci.3315-10.2010#Results: Early control of regenerative processes by sodium influx / Fig 1 text#ms222_250uM_0-24hpa

source.title: Induction of vertebrate regeneration by a transient sodium current
source.location: Results: Early control of regenerative processes by sodium influx / Fig 1 text

injury: tail amputated at midpoint between anus and tip

intervention.description: Tails amputated; tadpoles bathed in 250 uM MS222 for the first 24 h after amputation, then washed out

readout.method: Scoring of tail outgrowth by composite index categories (full, good, weak, none)

notes: Paper text gives only the percent of tails that failed to regenerate (n=106 tadpoles stated). Split of the remaining tails between full and partial regeneration is not given in text, so only 'none' is recorded; percent used as count, n_total left null to avoid inconsistent sum. Remainder = regenerated (full/partial unspecified).
